notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
[p][b]New Features & Content[/b][/p][p]New items: Miner Beacon and Phoenix Storm.
Added keyboard and controller input glyphs to the game.
[/p][p][b]Game Improvements[/b][/p][p]Various balance improvements to talents, artifacts, items and skills.
Reduced mass of elite enemies so pull and push abilities better work on them.
Adjusted gold pricing for common and rare items, and various interactions; increased gold resources from various planets.
Added a hard cap of 10 allies to the game; the % hp reduction overtime from some allies has been removed.
The final wave background now shifts to the reddish "Arcadium" background, and is now also animated during the final wave.
Slighty increased the base movement speed of all the spaceships.
Also the fifth stage is now available through the demo.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes and General Improvements[/b][/p][p]Fixed an issue where, after dying, the HP bar was still visible.
Fixed an issue where, "clear bomb" (from revives, end-game and cosmic rings) was not killing undead aliens (just transforming them).
Fixed an issue where the projectiles from Vulcan were targetting celestial beacons.
Fixed an issue where rerolling without gold would still change the current selections in the talent tree (only visually).
Fixed an issue where Living Sun item was still mentioning a duration.
Fixed a visual bug with Living Sun on game resume.
Fixed an issue where entities could spawn without full HP.
Fixed an issue where fiery phoenix was being destroyed by enemies explosions (treated as a simple bullet).
Fixed performance issues with stars and ricochet.
Fixed an issue where revenge blast and similar abilities could spawn indefinitely; also fixed an issue where those same abilities were not properly triggered when they had to.
Fixed an issue where a certain sundry alien could be invincible forever.
Fixed an issue where the game would still display 15 minutes stages, despite the stages now being 12 minutes.
Various fixes and improvements.[/p]

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
[p][b]New Features & Content[/b][/p][p]Feature revamp - Stars:
Finally now stars are a full blown feature![/p][olist][*][p]You can now find Star Crucibles in the middle of Stars! Burn all your good to get powerful items...even star-exclusive, legendary items!! (e.g. Living Sun item).[/p][/*][*][p]New star aliens, they now can drop gold.[/p][/*][*][p]Stars are now bigger, spaceship heating up is slower.[/p][/*][*][p]Player is now slightly slowed down inside a star (harder journey).[/p][/*][*][p]From the planets "lightest spot", you can now better tell where is the closest star.[/p][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44247822/87d9788414a1e9e8dd3254c66425866864e6cd01.png"][/img][/p][p]New spaceship: Aestas (unlockable through stars interactions).
New minibosses: Alien Splitter, Alien Spaceship.
New stage featuring planet sentinels.
New missions: The Golden Offering, Tyrant Reaper.
New artifact: Hyperfocus Lens.
New items: Galactic Cookie, Lunar Cheese, Living Sun, BioHull Impactor, Starpiercer, Fusion Core.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Game Improvements[/b][/p][p]The stages are now 12 minutes, rather than 15 minutes.
Merchant no longers run out of items (always fresh items available!)
Balance improvements (talents, ships, items, etc...)
The tutorial has been improved with better pacing and videos, including information about perfect landings (the most asked question in the game).
Base movement speed of all ships has been increased.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes and General Improvements[/b][/p][p]Fixed an issue where percentage healings of HP and energy were scaling with healing or energy bonuses.
Fixed an issue where the selected artifact details were not updated when browsing artifacts with gamepad.
Fixed an issue where celestial beacons showed both the blue arrow (item) and the orange one (fight event).
Fixed an issue where wishing space rifts rolled different items if you resumed a session.
Fixed an issue where only one visuals for moons was present.
Fixed an issue where, upon resuming a session, the same moons and planet defender aliens could re-spawn.
Fixed an issue where mission tiers didn't take it well when the game was updated and their requirements were changed.
Fixed an issue where the background could flash when defeating enemies.
Fixed an issue where passive items and artifacts were not selectable with gamepad.
Fixed an issue where reaching -1 defense would fully unlock Quest for Aegis.
Fixed an issue where contaminated planets started appearing from stage 6 instead of stage 7.
Fixed a few issues around gravity attractions with moons.
Fixed an issue where cloud load would not work.
Various fixes and improvements.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Of course, these changes are those applying to the release version, but many of them will touch the demo version too.[/p][p]I am also working hard so that the full Steam release (along with mobile) will be this year (2025), and [b]no further :)[/b][/p]

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
[b]Features & Content[/b]

New artifact Xeno Jammer with "Flawless Extraction" mission.
New artifact Aegis with "Quest for Aegis" mission.
New items Nebula Shredder and Pulse Drive Accelerator.
Now the tracker arrows can be displayed on the screen edges (previous default), as an ellipse (new default), and as a circle around the player. A new setting has been added to switch between these modes.

[b]Improvements[/b]

Planets now reward EXP by default.
Many missions are now easier to complete.
The first stages are now a bit harder.
Revival now also fully charges the skills.
The total amount of planets harvested is now displayed in the pause menu stats (as it's useful information for certain abilities).
Various balance changes.
Various improvements and fixes.

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
[b]Improvements[/b]

The main font has been replaced in favor of a much cleaner and sci-fi oriented font.
Further increased the base movement speed of all spaceships.
Improved the visibility of fully harvested planets (no more bumping easily into them).
Adjusted UI for certain screen ratios.
A shield with low HP no longer tanks any hit, but the remaining damage is transferred to the player (it was possible to abuse this mechanic to because almost immortal).

[b]Fixes[/b]

Fixed an issue where each Energy Discharge bullet could trigger the energy recharge effect multiple times, making it easy to fully charge your skills.
Fixed an issue where, when revived, Space Anomaly and various other effects stopped working.
Fixed an issue where, with only level 1 Molten Core, a star heat couldn't affect the player.
Fixed an issue where reviving after a death caused by heat would simply kill the player again.
Various fixes and improvements.

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
[b]Features & Content[/b]

Three new stages have been added.
You can now find gas planets in the Universe (from depth 9+).
New revival feature with its related item "Second Chance".
New artifact "Alien Threat Chronometer" which shows a cooldown bar for the next wave. This artifact is unlocked and equipped by default.
New item "Ion Veil".

[b]Improvements[/b]

Stages are now labelled as "depths" (depth 1, depth 2, etc...).
There's now a description of the unlocked features for each stage.
There's now a single stronger wave after you survived for half the time.
Contaminated planets now spawn enemies upon landing and not on approach.
Planet defenders now reward gold.
Various music additions and changes.
Removed "captain texts" for alien waves.

[b]Fixes[/b]

Fixed an issue where it was not possible to scroll through passive items on mobile.
Various fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Another big gameplay update is hitting Arcadium!
notes.content:
[b]Features & Content[/b]

Overhaul of the talent tree: introduced a tier system, overhauled the visuals of the tree, added new talents and balanced the current talents. The following talents have been added: Bullet Hell, Gamma Bolts, Space Rain, Star Shower, Cosmic Relay, Energy Surge and Gold Rush.
New passive items: Nano-Repair Module and Dark Matter Reactor.
New Mission "Celestial Champion" along with the artifact "Trascendental Stone".


[b]Improvements[/b]

Moons now reward both gold and exp upon destruction.
Rerolls can no longer present the same talents, but will bring 3 new selections. Rerolls are now cheaper.
Various adjustments to items and artifacts abilities.
The difficulty of endless mode has been slightly reduced.
Rewards from the music alien have been decreased.
Various fixes and improvements.


[b]Fixes[/b]

Fixed an issue where the game could freeze if you levelled up while in the talent panel.
Fixed an issue where the world had a smaller size than expected on certain devices.
Fixed an issue where in portrait mode the skill descriptions wouldn't fit inside the screen.
Fixed an issue involving abilities affected by depleted planets amount.
Fixed an issue where some events (e.g. merchant) were out of place.
Fixed an issue where on session resumal the planets took a few frames to spawn.
Fixed an issue where "rain" bullets abilities weren't properly calculating their positions.
Fixed an issue where the shields that activate abilities whenever they receive hits weren't properly working.
Fixed an issue where trigger talents would be triggered again on game resumal.
Semi-automatic shooting is now enabled by default.


Also, make sure to check out the new trailer!
[url=https://youtu.be/jx9J7Zi6Ac0 style=button]Trailer[/url]

notes.title: New Update and June Next Fest Participation
notes.content:
I am glad to announce that Arcadium - Space Odyssey will be partecipating in the Steam Next Fest June edition, which goes from June 10 to June 17!

Make sure to hang with us by joining the [url=https://discord.gg/5JwM7DcWPv]Discord Community[/url] for all the tips, tricks and fun!

Also, there's a new update to celebrate the Next Fest, which contains various improvements and fixes, listed below:

Some planets had too little gravity attraction, which made landing too hard. This has been fixed.
Slightly reduced the damage of the aliens and their amount in waves.
More movement is now allowed after landing before the harvesting halts.
The joystick now keeps track of the finger while choosing a talent, leading to a smoother experience.
Final wave is now more and more difficult toward the end, rather than having a similar difficulty through the two minutes.
Planets crashes won't damage the player anymore if they had too little impact (i.e. dealing only a few damages).
Some achievements have been made easier.
You can now pause/resume while playing through the controller start button.
Improved the deadzone for controllers while navigating the UI.
Added Steam Achievements (not in the demo).

Fixed an issue where items cooldowns wouldn't work anymore under specific conditions.
Fixed an issue with The Chaser target movement.
Fixed an issue where the gravity of the planets wasn't properly calculated.
Fixed an issue where Cosmic Ring charge wasn't visually updated.

notes.title: Major Update + Playtest + Endless Replayability Fest
notes.content:
Arcadium - Space Odyssey is partecipating in the Endless Replayability Fest, from 13rd May to 20th May!
A new update along with a limited time playtest is now available!

Here's the update notes:

[b]New Content[/b]

The new stage "Celestial Champion" has been added.
The new feature "Celestial Nexus" has been added; available from "Celestial Champion" stage and forward.
The new spaceship "Cupid" has been added.
Several new items have been added: "Frenzied Charge", "Darkstorm", "Nova Sentry Call", "Nova Sentry", "Vitality Shield", "Space Fishing Rod", "Bio Hull Protection", "Alien Chaser".


[b]Improvements[/b]

Golden Statuettes have been replaced by "Cosmic Essence"; the description of the item has been improved. Cosmic essence, unlike statuettes, are not bought from the merchant but are dropped with a low chance by any enemy in the universe.
Improved the size of the game's world when playing with a small screen.
Slightly improved the base speed of all spaceships.
There's now a tremble visual effect when you take damage from crashing on a planet.
Several changes have been added to make it so that it's easier to recognize when you're taking resources from a planet, how many resources are left, and when you fully harvested a planet.
Upon resuming a session, the game now also remembers items on the ground, broken allies that where repaired, and eventual allies that were with you.
Sentry Gun skill from Antevorta has been overhauled.
Consumable items are no longer a thing; the current two consumable items (cookies and cheese) are now pickups.
Some items received a visual overhaul.
Moved UI Scale to Video settings rather than General.
Simplified description for several abilities.
The stage specific feature has now a much higher chance to appear in the universe for that stage.
Improved the visibility of the interaction button.
Skills are no longer mentioned by "base" and "advanced" but rather by "first" and "second".
Improved animation for items spawn.


[b]Fixes[/b]

Fixed an issue where landing aid was not applied correctly.
Fixed an issue where if you modified your attack pattern two or more times through abilities, you would keep a modified attack pattern.
Fixed an issue where comets were ignoring moons.
Fixed an issue where markets would still be marked with an arrow even when everything was bought.
Fixed a crash issue when the FPS were set to maximum in the options.
Fixed an issue where stats attributes for broken allies where not applied on repair.
Various improvements and fixes.

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
[b]Features & Content[/b]

Endless stage has been added (available in the coming Open Beta November 6th - November 13th).
More missions have been added.
New minibosses have been added.
Elite aliens have been added, bigger and stronger versions of current aliens.
New planets have been added; gas planets have been temporarily removed as they just make for worse planets. They'll likely come back as a new feature with different functionality.
New item "Gold Fueled Might Influx".

[b]Improvements[/b]

The demo will now show certain content (as locked) from the future full version of the game.
The spaceships Janus and Antevorta have been overhauled.
The gold counter is now always visible, and no longer appears/disappears based on proximity with a merchant or other gold-oriented events.
Most of the talents, items and artifacts have been rebalanced and/or improved in their behaviours.
Skills are no longer referenced as "base" and "advanced", but rather as "first" and "second".
Various UI and GUI improvements pretty much everywhere.
Diamond of Resilience (infected planet's passive item) no longer grants resistance but defense, which is a new stat. While resistance decreases damage received by %, defense decreases damage received by a flat amount.
Waves of enemies have been better balanced.
Missions will now show the reward's title and description.
Space Rifts and Music Aliens have been made clearer in their behaviours.
Improved performance in the late-game (benefits mostly mobile users).
Most of the smaller texts and interactable buttons have been increased in size.
Base speed of all spaceships has been slightly increased.
Highlighted numbers in descriptions now correctly highlights stats that change between levels rather than all stats.
Restoration bar fill now uses a different color than the harvesting one, to make it more clear you're in the restoration phase with infected planets.
Reduced the amount of infected planets around.
Added a small spawn animation for the player.
Locked spaceships will now show which mission you must complete to unlock them.
Waves generated from infected planets are now smaller and weaker.
The player's HP bar is now always on top and cannot be hidden by enemies.
The Merchant won't "run out of items" as easily as before.
Further performance and balance improvements.

[b]Fixes[/b]

Fixed an issue where explosive aliens could push you at the speed of light (usually toward a planet, leading to an immediate death).
Fixed an issue where defeating aliens on an infected planet without absorbing the planet could be exploited into infinitely farmable exp by quitting and resuming the run.
Fixed an issue where, after ending a run, the continue button was still there in the main menu.
Fixed an issue where fire particles still appeared when using Adamant item.
Fixed an issue where Overwhelming Splendor could hit unintended targets.
Fixed an issue where the Recover HP talent wasn't working and had no visual effect.
Fixed an issue where perfect landings weren't properly registered in certain scenarios.
Fixed an issue where big stars could lead the background to change all of sudden.
Fixed an issue where the aliens wouldn't move properly after being frozen.
Fixed an issue where under specific conditions, planets would appear all of sudden, with no prior tracking.
Fixed an issue where the ship's communication suddenly stops.
Fixed a few issues around the music where it would stop or repeat where it didn't have to.
Fixed an issue where The Bait and Sentry Guns were reacting to gravity.
Fixed a visual issue with Mercury spaceship while it moves.
Fixed an issue where certain looping sounds kept playing as you went to the home screen from a run.
Fixed an issue where the shoot aim would jitter on automatic shooting as the enemy moved.
Fixed an issue with Neptune "The Hunt" skill where it would never end; the skill has also been improved.
Fixed an error with Magic Dice artifact.
Fixed an issue with NPCs messages being wrongly assigned to different targets (e.g. a drone talking as it was the Merchant).
Fixed an issue where BOOManiac would explode all enemies when selected.
Fixed an issue where you could get 2+ items out of a single infected planet.
Fixed an issue where the tutorial's video would stutter.
Fixed an issue where Radiant Bomb wouldn't hit certain targets (e.g. moons).
Fixed an issue where the spaceship would slightly move by itself when sitting lateral to a planet, eventually stopping the resource harvesting.
Fixed an issue where "fake arrows" that would point to planets appeared, but no planet was there.
Fixed a visual issue with shadow aliens.
Fixed layout issues with artifact descriptions.
Fixed an issue where items could appear with the consumable icon, albeit not being consumable.
Fixed an issue when getting multiple items on succession the notification could have the wrong text.
Fixed an issue where UI elements could display in the device "unsafe area" (mobile notch).
Fixed an issue where Space Time Drift Stars had an incorrect direction and velocity.
Fixed an issue where you could spawn more minibosses by going to infected planets at the right time.
Fixed an issue where you could close the talents level up panel.
Fixed an issue where on mobile devices the orientation was always portrait at startup.
Fixed an issue where aliens which were spawned by other aliens were not tracked and didn't have certain features.
Fixed an issue where the artifact Advanced Radar had an incorrect maximum level.
Fixed an issue where the descriptions of artifacts displayed in the pause menu and game over took in consideration also the ones you've obtained in that same run.
Various fixes and improvements.

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
[b]Features & Content[/b]

New artifact "Xeno Transmitter" and its related mission have been added; this new artifact reduces the peace-time between waves, for players who seek a more fight-intensive experience.
Upon destruction, moons will now drop exp gemstones; there's also a small chance to drop "lunar cheese", a consumable item.
The first miniboss has been added to the game, more minibosses will follow in the future.


[b]Improvements[/b]

The currently equipped artifacts are now visible without having to go to the artifacts panel.
A new panel for stage selection has been added, which also reminds the player of their stage level and goal.
The duration of stages has been reduced from 20 minutes to 15 minutes, condensing the fun of the game even further.
The game now shows the best survived time of a specific stage.
Reduced the amount of times moons go rogue.


[b]Fixes[/b]

Fixed an issue where the talents "Multishot" and "Around The Corner" could be in conflict with each other, where Multishot buffed the back bullets rather than the front ones. Specifically, the bullets shot by "Around The Corner" will not be buffed by "Multishot" and will not count toward talents such as "Frostblade Barrage".
Fixed an issue where items spawned from wishing rifts were not tracked.
Fixed an issue where the green broken ally could hit enemies from its broken staste.
Various improvements and fixes.

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Features & Content

A new system that will slightly aid the player in perfect landings (by rotating the spaceship when nearby a planet) has been added.
New artifacts: Golden Clover, Planetary Drill, Premium Membership, Voidborn Dilemma, Planet Touchdown Extractor.
New items: Tidal Force, Energizing Flurry.

Improvements

The artifact system has been overhauled: you no longer have to upgrade artifacts, and the UI has been improved. Artifacts will upgrade as you get them in the Universe, without using gemstones.
Changed the movement controls for keyboard users, the old movement system is now available by turning the option "rudder controls" to true. The rudder controls have been slightly improved as well (more natural feeling when turning around).
Steel X asteroid no longer cancel small hits.
Talent upgrade choices are now determined by the seed, so you get the same choices even if you leave and continue a run.
Artifacts won't keep on dropping when you already have it maxed.

Fixes

Fixed an issue where fast-selecting spaceships resulte in a visual glitch.
Fixed an issue where the game would not save after you continue a run.
Fixed an issue where aliens would not come to you when you were nearby the merchant.
Various fixes and improvements.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where fast-selecting spaceships resulte in a visual glitch.
Fixed an issue where the game would not save after you continue a run.
Fixed an issue where aliens would not come to you when you were nearby the merchant.

notes.title: Demo Release
notes.content:
The demo for Arcadium - Space Odyssey has been released through patch [i]23.06.17-demo[/i].
Make sure to try it out and let me know what you think about the game; the game will be shaped also through your feedback!
The best place to provide feedback and chat directly with the me is through the game's [url=https://discord.com/invite/BbrJtK4ZS6]Discord[/url]!

Many more updates will follow, including demo updates!
But for now, here's a summary of the patch:

[b]Features & Content[/b]
Perfect Landing: if you land carefully and precisely on a planet, a perfect landing will trigger, depleting the planet’s resources twice as fast.
New items: "Gold Fueled Power Influx", "Quasar Quick-Repair", "Space-Time Doubler".

[b]Improvements[/b]
The merchant has been overhauled.
There's now a stable time between alien waves, to allow players more time to explore even if they defeat the aliens slowly.
The initial wave has been removed, the player can now explore a bit before fighting its first wave.
Pickups are now saved so you can now resume a session and find the unpicked pickups.
The background nebulae now darkens before a wave, and lighten ups once the wave has been defeated to warn the player and ease the contrast between enemies and background.
Changed saving checkpoint from after-planet to after-wave.
Duration and difficulty of stages has been slightly changed.
Improved damage from "Energy Discharge" talent.
External links buttons now have a prompt.
Percentages of percentages are now correctly displayed in abilities descriptions.
Music alien artifact, now named "Space Lullaby", has been reworked.
Heat aliens artifact has been changed.
Added some transparency to the game over screen so you can keep looking at the world scene.
Mercury has a new ability that allows the spaceship to restore HP whenever it gains gold.
Golden Statuette item's price decreased to 10 gold.
Asteroids aliens won't spawn in the first stage anymore.
Steel X asteroids can now also be destroyed through high-damage hits.
Spaceships overhaul.
There's now a music transition when fighting an alien wave.
Golden arrows are now used for gold-oriented events.
Comets have been reworked.
“HP Up” talent changed to "Vitality Augment", it now adds healing bonus as well.

[b]Fixes[/b]
Fixed an issue where the next stage would be unlocked even if you lost.
Fixed an issue where UI scale was not set to 80% by default on standalone platforms.
Fixed an issue where transformed items would not correctly save.
Fixed an issue where you could skip a stage by pressing on Next Stage after you’ve survived.
Fixed an issue where the game would not pause when losing focus.
Fixed an issue where you could play with locked spaceships.
Fixed an issue where the back button would not work after a session.
Fixed an issue where sentinel aliens would not shoot.
Fixed issues with stage default selections.
Fixed an issue that would make enemies unable to move on new sessions.
Fixed an issue where obtaining multiple levels at the same time would result in the game staying in pause mode even after picking the talents.
Fixed an issue where the Ricochet talent would not work.
Fixed an issue where infected planets restoration would not work.
Fixed an issue where aliens could chase and persist in the world for too long.
Fixed an issue where enemies could follow bullets due to aggro.
Fixed an issue where EM barrier would not scale when its talent was upgraded.
Fixed an issue where you could not interact with UI after changing a keybinding.
Fixed an issue where a drone would shoot from afar but could be heard as it was nearby.
Fixed an issue where the “Breaking Ball” would not be disposed after its duration.
Fixed an issue that allowed the player to keep playing at Game Over, if they survived.
Fixed an issue where hitting asteroid aliens would not wake them up.
Fixed an issue where the comet was pushable through bullets.
Fixed an issue where critical chance, critical damage, and certain passive abilities were ignored by spawn-related abilities.
Fixed an issue where you could pause the game while the planet landing video was playing.
Fixed an issue where Fire Storm and many other abilities were unable to hit more than once the same enemy.
Fixed an issue where rewards were not shown correctly.
Fixed an issue where the spaceship would keep on shotting after taking a talent.
Fixed an issue where aliens would stay away from the recovery spot's healing circle.
Various fixes and improvements.
